Back to the ships!|First Mate Gunter|{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}}}} A '''pirate transport''' was utilized by [[Silvo's pirates|Captain Brutus' crew]] during the [[New Republic Era]]. Around [[9 ABY]], a group of [[pirate]]s led by [[First Mate]] [[Gunter]] traveled aboard this [[Starship|vessel]] to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]], where they captured former [[Captain]] [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]] to put him on [[Trial of Silvo|trial]] upon returning to their [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]]. ==Characteristics== The [[transport]] had a long, elongated body and a hull covered in a mix of a mix of [[Color|gray]], white, and dark-blue panels. The [[Starship|ship]] featured multiple protruding sections, including wings and [[engine]]s at the rear, as well as a total of four [[laser cannon]]s. ==History== {{Quote|Zentin, Silvo, whatever you call him. I'm claiming your bounty.''"
"[on comms] ''Where is the cowardly wretch?''"
"''Here is the coordinates. Now hot about my payment?''"
"''You'll have your payment when I have Silvo. I'm sending two ships. And keep this quiet.''"
"''I wouldn't dream of breathing a word to anyone. I'll be seeing you. ''[device beeps]''|Pocket and Brutus|}} [[File:ShipsOnLanupa.png|thumb|right|250px|The transport amid other vessels on Lanupa]] Around [[9 ABY]],{{SkeletonCrewDate}} a group of [[Captain]] [[Brutus]]'s [[pirate]]s led by [[First Mate]] [[Gunter]] used this [[starship]], along with a [[Unidentified pirate transport 2|smaller one]], to travel to the [[planet]] [[Lanupa]], where the [[bounty hunter]] [[Pokkit]] claimed to have spotted the runaway [[prison]]er [[Jod Na Nawood|Silvo]], a former crew member and captain. Upon exiting [[hyperspace]], the larger vessel was the first to descend into the [[atmosphere]], with two [[Lanupan security vessel]]s moving in to flank it ''en route'' to the [[Skull Ridge Mountain Hotel & Spa]].{{Getty|url=thewaltdisneystudios/allaccess/#!asset/bj8gqtnvm799njt6mjc6t|text=GR-FF-001420|date=2024-12-23}} As a Lanupan [[pilot]] communicated with the transport's crew over radio, the second pirate craft opened fire from behind, destroying both security vessels and clearing the way for the two pirate ships to land near the [[hotel]]. Upon landing, the pirates descended underground in pursuit of Silvo, who was searching for [[Captain Rennod's Lair]] alongside the [[youngling]]s from the [[Skeleton Crew]].{{SWYouTube|T19XifsgFS0|Skeleton Crew | Blast from the Past | Streaming Dec 2 on Disney+}} After failing to capture him, the crew returned to surface, arresting a few [[Lanupa security officer|security guards]] in the process. Back on the landing platform, the pirates apprehended Silvo as he emerged from a ground-embedded access hatch. Just as they were about to escort him to the transport, they spotted an approaching [[New Republic]] [[squadron]]. When first Mate Gunter ordered a retreat, the crew boarded their ships and blasted off, trying to evade the [[X-wing starfighter]]s attacking them midair. Although the smaller vessel was destroyed, the larger one managed to escape. Despite sustaining partial damage, it made it back to the [[Silvo's pirate frigate|frigate]], where Silvo was put on [[Trial of Silvo|trial]]. ==Behind the scenes== The pirate transport debuted in "[[You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates]]," the fifth episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', which aired on [[December 24]], [[2024]].{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}} Before the premiere, the ship was first portrayed in the official trailer of the series.{{SWYouTube|f19gfOMZTtg|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Disney+}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified pirate transport 1}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Way, Way Out Past the Barrier}} {{1st}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Very Interesting, As an Astrogation Problem}} *{{SkeletonCrew|You Have a Lot to Learn About Pirates}} *{{SkeletonCrew|Zero Friends Again}} *{{SkeletonCrew|The Real Good Guys}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|f19gfOMZTtg|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Disney+}} {{1stp}} *{{SWYouTube|SBFoAS156lQ|Skeleton Crew | Official Clip | Episode 6 Now Streaming on Disney+}} ==Notes and references== {{ScrollBox|{{Reflist}}}} {{Interlang |fr=Transport pirate non-identifié 1 |ka=მეკობრეების უცნობი გადამყვანი 1 }} [[Category:Starships of Silvo's pirates]] [[Category:Transports]]
